svg.title: The five functional prerequisites
svg.desc: Replacing personnel, teaching new recruits, producing and distributing goods and services, preserving order, and providing a sense of purpose.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FIVE TASKS A SOCIETY MUST ACCOMPLISH TO SURVIVE
